dedupe_keys.name: crop production exposure data for humanitarian response plan countries climada eth zurich

description: This HDX dataset from the ETH Zurich Weather and Climate Risks group provides crop production exposure in tonnes for the 23 countries with Humanitarian Response Plans, such as Afghanistan, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ethiopia, Haiti, Somalia, Sudan, Ukraine and Yemen. It is derived from global 4 km gridded yield simulations for maize, rice, soybean and wheat, an ensemble of eight global gridded crop models driven by bias-corrected output of five climate models from the ISIMIP project, and is summarised by first-level administrative unit in 24 CSV files (one combined, one per country); the reference year is 2018. Data come from the CLIMADA data API in a form ready for CLIMADA risk analyses, are released under CC BY 4.0 with no warranty, and HDX lists a yearly update frequency. Caveats: the provider warns that a 4 km grid is not suitable for neighbourhood-level risk, and that users must check how hazards and exposure are represented in the API metadata and publications. For simulation it gives agricultural exposure values for fragile countries that can be combined with flood, drought or tropical cyclone hazard sets to estimate crop losses and food supply shocks. Related catalogue records include the CLIMADA platform and the GGCMI global gridded crop model outputs.
